ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio; approximately 75% low-intensity (black) base with 25% high-intensity (white) localized mottling and scarring.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe contains a dense cluster of circular white high-intensity blobs concentrated in the lateral and mid-sections. Right lobe features a large, contiguous high-intensity white patch on the medial-trailing edge, with smaller circular clusters at the lateral tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 40 degrees relative to the horizontal plane of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, high-frequency serrations with pixel-amplitudes of 5-15 pixels along the trailing boundary, showing more pronounced jaggedness on the lateral distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curve fitted to the trailing edges, sweeping upward from the median notch to the lateral termini.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive spatial distribution of circular high-contrast white pixel clusters across the entire left lobe surface and the distal end of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct series of parallel, vertical low-intensity linear marks (rake marks) cutting through the high-intensity white patch on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent linear rake marks on the right lobe and extensive circular scarring across both lobes consistent with long-term parasitic colonization or contact trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique high-contrast vertical striping pattern on the medial-right lobe patch, creating a zebra-like visual signature.
